Based on the onboarding documentation, Hermes Agent supports outbound delivery of MCP image outputs to messaging gateways (such as Telegram) via the **`MEDIA:<path>`** syntax. 

To ensure the agent forwards images produced by MCP tools to your gateway:
- Have your tool return or output the generated image reference formatted as `MEDIA:<path>` (pointing to the local file path of the image). 
- Hermes Agent's gateway integration will automatically detect this format and deliver the media natively to Telegram.
